structure TemporalNode where

def TemporalNode.init (id : Nat) (initial_state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalNode :=
  let initial_version := NodeVersion.init Nat.zero timestamp_ns initial_state
  { node_id := id
  , versions := [initial_version]
  , current_version := Nat.zero
  , created_at := timestamp_ns
  , last_modified := timestamp_ns }

def TemporalNode.addVersion (self : TemporalNode) (state : QuantumState) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalNode :=
  let new_version_num := List.length self.versions

  { node_id := self.node_id
  , versions := List.append self.versions [new_version]
  , current_version := new_version_num
  , created_at := self.created_at
  , last_modified := timestamp_ns }

  let new_version_num := List.length self.versions
  let new_version := NodeVersion.initWithProperties new_version_num timestamp_ns state props
  { node_id := self.node_id

  getNthNodeVersion? self.versions version_num

def TemporalNode.getCurrentVersion (self : TemporalNode) : Option NodeVersion :=
  TemporalNode.getVersion self self.current_version

def TemporalNode.getVersionAt (self : TemporalNode) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : Option NodeVersion :=
  latestNodeVersionAtAux self.versions timestamp_ns none

def TemporalNode.rollback (self : TemporalNode) (target_version : Nat) : TemporalNode :=
  match TemporalNode.getVersion self target_version with
  | none => self
  | some version =>
      { node_id := self.node_id
      , versions := self.versions
      , current_version := target_version
      , created_at := self.created_at
      , last_modified := version.timestamp }

def TemporalNode.rollbackSucceeded (self : TemporalNode) (target_version : Nat) : Bool :=
  match TemporalNode.getVersion self target_version with
  | none => Bool.false
  | some _ => Bool.true

def TemporalNode.rollbackToTime (self : TemporalNode) (timestamp_ns : Timestamp) : TemporalNode :=
  match TemporalNode.getVersionAt timestamp_ns with
  | none => self
  | some version => TemporalNode.rollback self version.version
